mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_detail (user_id, username, avatar, age, bio) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, CONCAT('https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=', #{username}), NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT d.user_id AS userId, d.username AS username, d.avatar AS avatar, d.age AS age, d.bio AS bio, CASE WHEN f.status = 1 THEN 'friends' WHEN f.status = 0 AND f.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 'request_sent' WHEN f.status = 0 AND f.friend_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 'request_received' ELSE 'none' END AS friendStatus FROM sys_user_detail d INNER JOIN sys_user u ON d.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_friend f ON ( (f.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND f.friend_id = d.user_id) OR (f.friend_id = #{currentUserId} AND f.user_id = d.user_id) ) WHERE u.status = 1 AND d.user_id != #{currentUserId} AND d.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY d.user_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
